items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: What was his name? Charley something.

ctx.x: Now, do you remember when you first came into contact with gangsters? When were you first aware of gangsters in the clubs?

I was first aware of gangsters in the clubs, it was at Burnham, Illinois. There was a club out there called the Burnham Inn. B-u-r-n-h-a-m, Burnham Inn. It was in Burnham, Illinois. I used to have to take a train to get out there. And when I went out -- I was working out there and making a whole lot of money, and I know that's the first time I knew that I was working with gangsters. And then I was naive again, because this fellow that -- fellow that killed somebody and got away and they finally caught him. What…
